expectations.text: Logging captures the full stack trace, not just an error code or message
expectations.evidence: Reply lists '例外のスタックトレース'; sample log shows Traceback with KeyError.
Logs cursor, page, counts, failed record id and raw JSON (2000-char cap), HTTP status/reason/body.

expectations.text: Logs persisted durably (file), since cron discards stdout/stderr
expectations.evidence: SYNC_WORKER_LOG env var, default /tmp/sync_worker.log; explicitly notes print would be discarded by cron.

expectations.text: Reply explicitly reasons about the round-trip cost as justification for one-shot logging
expectations.evidence: '変更が必要なら CI 40 分がもう一往復するため、あえてコード内で完結させました' — cost-aware, though framed around cron config rather than log-content sufficiency.
